snippet.title: Blotch - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Blotch is a stealth adventure where you paint yourself to match the world around you.

Paint yourself to match the scenery and sneak past guards. Explore an island of magical paintings, help its residents save their homes, or bring friends for online hide-and-seek and Prop Hunt. Create your own maps and share them on Steam Workshop.

Wishlist and Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4933300/Blotch/

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Whd3QahE8Z

#godot #steamnextfest #indiegame
